_meta.description: SQL Server Operational Signal Pack — UI labels for opportunity cards
_meta.compliance_note: Agent surfaces operational signals to IT managers only. No automated ticket resolution or SLA override.

DB_TICKET_VOLUME_SURGE.s6_why: Recent ticket intake is significantly above your 90-day average, suggesting an operational event or capacity gap that is not yet visible in SaaS systems.
DB_TICKET_VOLUME_SURGE.s6_action: An agent can monitor daily ticket intake against your baseline, surface surge alerts to IT managers before queues back up, and cross-reference with ServiceNow incident trends.

DB_SLA_BREACH_RATE.s6_why: More than 15% of tickets are breaching SLA in the last 30 days. This pattern typically precedes escalations and customer satisfaction impact.
DB_SLA_BREACH_RATE.s6_action: An agent can track SLA compliance in real time, alert assignment groups before breach occurs, and identify which ticket categories drive the highest breach rate.

DB_QUEUE_DEPTH_ELEVATED.s6_why: The number of open P1 and P2 tickets has exceeded the configured threshold. Elevated critical queue depth is a leading indicator of service disruption risk.
DB_QUEUE_DEPTH_ELEVATED.s6_action: An agent can monitor P1/P2 queue depth against configurable thresholds, trigger escalation workflows when depth is sustained, and surface oldest tickets to shift leads automatically.
